mapper.delete: DELETE FROM email_verification WHERE (target = #{target} AND purpose = #{purpose}) OR reg_dt < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification (target, purpose, code_hash, attempt_cnt, expire_dt, reg_dt) VALUES (#{target}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, 0, NOW() + (#{ttlMin} || ' minutes')::INTERVAL, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET expire_dt = NOW() WHERE verify_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT verify_id::TEXT AS row_id, target, purpose, code_hash, attempt_cnt::TEXT AS attempt_cnt FROM email_verification WHERE target = #{target} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND expire_dt > NOW() ORDER BY verify_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET attempt_cnt = attempt_cnt + 1 WHERE verify_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM email_verification WHERE target = #{target} AND purpose = #{purpose}
